title: Best video color grading software in 2026 includes Adobe Premiere
summary: Professional color grading software can make or break the look of a video, and Adobe Premiere gives everyone from novices to seasoned professionals the tools to achieve cinematic results. Adobe Premiere offers a lot of color grading options for video Capturing the video you need for a project is only half of the battle. Sometimes the footage you capture matches your creative vision with minimal editing, but when it isn't quite right, color grading can get you the rest of the way. While some entry-level video editing tools rely heavily on basic filters, professional color grading software provides greater control over color, contrast, exposure, and tonal adjustments.
